description: Unit tests for the TlsChloExtractor class in the QUIC protocol implementation, testing TLS Client Hello extraction, session resumption, multi-packet handling, and move semantics.

classes.name: TlsChloExtractorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing TLS Client Hello extraction in QUIC.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes test packets with a first flight of packets.

methods.name: Initialize (overload)
methods.description: Initializes test packets with a first flight of packets using a custom crypto config.

methods.description: Performs a full handshake to insert an SSL_SESSION for TLS resumption testing.

methods.name: IngestPackets
methods.description: Processes captured packets and feeds them into the TLS extractor.

methods.description: Validates the extracted Client Hello details against expected values.

methods.name: IncreaseSizeOfChlo
